description: MediaPipe Pose Landmarker (lite) landmarks from two on-device screen recordings of front-view push-ups (phone low on the floor, user facing it). Raw (unsmoothed) landmarks normalized to the camera preview, resampled to 15 fps; per frame [x, y, visibility] for each landmarkIndices entry, x/y in thousandths, visibility in hundredths; null = no pose.

clips.name: v1
clips.notes: Walk in, plank held from ~8.5s; 6 reps (the first right after setup); kneel, stand and walk away 21-28s; back into the plank, 5 reps; stand up and walk to the phone 36.5-40s (garbage poses at the end).

clips.name: v2
clips.notes: Walk in, plank by ~6s; 9 fast reps (~0.8s each); stand up 15.7-17.5s.
